name: Orm

max_level.notes: This Titan is at the maximum level.

description: Orm is a mighty Titan of Elarite and a strong support for the Water element. His skill absorbs part of the damage dealt to all allies before unleashing a devastating blow upon a doomed enemy.

skills.name: Devastating Link
skills.description: Binds all allies to the enemy in the center for 8.0 seconds. Accumulates a portion of damage taken by allies and deals it to the enemy when the effect ends.

artifacts.name: Zorval's Rite
artifacts.description: When a titan uses the Devastating Link skill in combat, it can trigger an effect that gives bonus stats to the whole team for 9 seconds.

artifacts.name: Elarite Crown
artifacts.notes: Unique Elarite crown artifact shared among Elarite-class titans.

artifacts.name: Chthonic Balance Seal
artifacts.notes: Unique Elarite seal artifact shared among Elarite-class titans.

best_teams.name: Water Team with Nova Tank
best_teams.notes: Time muito bom usando Nova como tanque. Mesmo sendo uma atiradora, ao se posicionar na linha de frente ela ganha energia rapido e usa a ultimate para atordoar os inimigos.

best_teams.name: Water Team with Sigurd Tank
best_teams.notes: Com Sigurd como tanque, o time ganha protecao quando ele ativa a ultimate e fica imune por 5 segundos, segurando o dano antes que chegue aos aliados.

team_member_notes.Hyperion: Super Titan, marksman, healing and damage.
team_member_notes.Mairi: Support titan that decreases enemies' attack by 40%.

lore: Meet Orm, a mighty Titan of Elarite and a strong support for the Water element.

notes: Orm has two elements: Elarite and Water.
His Devastating Link skill is designed to protect allies by storing part of incoming damage and returning it as a powerful hit.
